subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should this intermediate stack slice run synchronous shadow accounting on every refreshed Codex scan before the later safety, bounding, and optimization slices land?
rationale: Legacy totals remain compatible, but accepting potentially multi-minute additional refresh work during an intermediate stack state is a maintainer-owned availability decision that the later-head replay cannot settle.

options.title: Gate shadow until final slice
options.body: Land the accounting code disabled or outside the response-critical path, then enable it after the safety and performance slices have exact combined proof.

options.title: Accept intermediate overhead
options.body: Merge this slice as written and explicitly accept that cold and refreshed scans may incur both legacy and lineage calculation time until later PRs land.

options.title: Review stack as one unit
options.body: Pause this PR until all four stacked branches can be evaluated as one coherent upgrade, performance, and rollback plan.

recommendation.title: Gate shadow until final slice
recommendation.body: Land the accounting code disabled or outside the response-critical path, then enable it after the safety and performance slices have exact combined proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest scanner containment merged through this owner, who is best positioned to accept or gate repository-wide refresh latency.
